The seven church planting phases and their exit criteria are:

1. **Discovery** — Core values documented; foundational modules complete; coach assigned.
2. **Core Group Development** — 30 committed adults; growth still moving; launch funding viable; worship leader identified; geographic area set.
3. **Launch Team Formation** — All eight team leaders assigned; launch date set.
4. **Training & Preparation** — Team training complete; systems tested; inside the final launch window.
5. **Pre-Launch (final three to four weeks)** — Launch readiness checklist complete; pre-launch services held; promotion executed.
6. **Launch Sunday** — First service held; guest data entered; debrief done.
7. **Post-Launch** — No exit criteria listed; this is marked as the terminal phase.
